## Custom GUI Mod v1.0.1

### Added
- Multiple deck system
- Deck create, switch, list and delete commands
- Separate card storage for each deck
- Card-based damage bonus
- Damage bonus now includes cards from all decks

### Fixed
- HP bar now displays actual entity health
- Vanilla drops from custom mobs are disabled
- Custom mobs no longer duplicate after server restarts
- Improved custom mob rendering
- Hidden vanilla entity name above custom mobs

### Other
- Updated MongoDB player structure for deck support
- Updated README and project documentation
